svg.title: Right triangle (0, 0), (6, 0), (0, 8)
svg.desc: Case sketch for this worked example.
svg.text: Hypotenuse from (6, 0) to (0, 8); centre is the midpoint (3, 4), radius 5.
If Math ERROR, swap so two points do not share a y-value as the first pair — enter (0, 8) first: 0 【EXE】 8 【EXE】 0 【EXE】 0 【EXE】 6 【EXE】 0 【EXE】
